DORMI additional original listening music — provenance and use note

These scores and recordings were newly created for the requesting user through
procedural composition and synthesis. No external recordings, sample libraries,
soundfonts, game audio, or supplied third-party melodies were used. The synthesis
code has no network dependency at runtime.

No additional third-party media attribution requirement was identified for these
newly generated scores or audio. Their use remains subject to the terms governing
the generating service and applicable law. No representation is made that an
AI-generated score or recording is eligible for copyright in every jurisdiction,
or that unintentional similarity to any existing work has been exhaustively ruled
out. Python, NumPy, SciPy and FFmpeg are separate tools with their own licenses;
their executables and libraries are not included in this package.

These are original procedural synthetic music assets, not premium AI music API
output, live instrumental recordings, or a soundtrack from an existing game.
